reasons.claim: Notification is a 9.67 ha polygon (Föryngringsavverkning, Orsa), status 'Anmält för avverkning'.
Completed felling overlaps only 0.6% of the polygon (a 2004 felling), so the site is not already felled.

Four eligible species were recorded within 250 m: Bryoria bicolor (EN, 137 m), Bryoria tenuis (EN, 207 m), Goodyera repens (VU, 99 m), Alectoria sarmentosa (VU, 184 m). All are site-bound, forest-associated and have felling-relevant threats. The latest records are from 2025 and the uncertainty is 5-20 m.
Six site-bound forest NT species were also recorded within 250 m, which is supporting evidence. They include Bryoria nadvornikiana, Hypogymnia vittata, Cystostereum murrayi and Lobaria scrobiculata.
Effort is adequate (58th county percentile, 82 records), so the many records are not just an effort artefact. Near-site effort within 250 m is 48 records, against a county median of 3.

uncertainties: Records are 99-207 m from the polygon edge. None of the eligible species is shown inside the polygon.
The records show the species were recorded, not that they occupy the felling area now.
The Red List category describes extinction risk, not legal protection.
not_established: Whether any of these species occur within the felled area itself.
Whether felling would affect these species or their habitat.
The stand's ecological condition. No tool output describes it, and the notification only lists 'Normal skog'.
next_action: Send for human ecological review before felling starts. Check the locations of the 2025 lichen and vascular plant records against the polygon boundary, and consider a field survey of the stand edge and interior.
